name: cygnus-trailer
description: Remotion-Trailer für den Cygnus-Spielmodus auf OneLiteFeather

scripts.render:all: npm run render:teaser && npm run render:short && npm run render:thumbnail
scripts.music: python3 scripts/generate_music.py out/music && for n in teaser short; do remotion ffmpeg -y -hide_banner -loglevel error -i out/music/cygnus-$n.wav -c:a libopus -b:a 160k public/music/cygnus-$n.ogg; done
